name: wolf pelt
blurb: A rough northern pelt. The merchant pays coin for these.

name: wolf tooth
blurb: Whole enough to keep. Not much else to say for it.

name: cracked fang
blurb: Longer than a tooth has any right to be.

name: stringy meat
blurb: Edible only in the sense that it is not a rock.

name: wool bandage
blurb: Clean enough. Restores a little health.

name: trail ration
blurb: Salt, fat, and a hard biscuit. Restores more health.

name: worn woodsman's axe
blurb: The edge is honest, if tired.

name: bearded handaxe
blurb: Shorter haft, keener bite, quicker back to the guard.

name: ash staff
blurb: A walking staff with an iron-shod tip. A poor axe, and a fair focus.

name: yarrow draught
blurb: A bitter green drink. It costs. It also puts you back on your feet.

name: wolf helm
blurb: The wolf's snout sits on your brow. Its open mouth frames your face.
